dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: Eh? You... you seem to have found all the treasure chests and Moonchase Charms that I marked out for you.

dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: Not bad, Traveler. Not bad at all.

dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: Still, I can't tell you about the locations of anymore chests or charms today. These are the rules, so please understand...
